takes.label: Take A — provenance first
promptSet: Find Nori's belief about the warehouse toolbox accusation.
Trace exactly how that claim reached Nori, including rejected branches.
Evaluate the currently registered dialogue and quest conditions.
Stage the repair account as canon, repair the wrong-layer condition, and surface the optional archive without approving anything.
Show the canon operation by itself.
Try Apply before the page has reviewed every operation.
Apply patch revision one using only the decisions already stored by the page.

segments.title: The bugs that counters hide
segments.narration: Changing one fact in a narrative game can silently fix one quest gate while breaking a different quest gate. Canon Ledger is a Web M C P belief-state debugger for that failure. It keeps objective canon separate from what every N P C remembers and believes.

segments.title: search_world
segments.narration: I ask search world for Nori's view of the warehouse theft. The live belief matrix narrows to one row: Nori believes Tatsu stole the toolbox.

segments.title: trace_claim_provenance
segments.narration: Trace claim provenance shows why. The claim began with Gen, passed through Hana and Sue, and reached Nori at hop three, with stored distortion at each transfer. A separate attempted branch was refused. Refused is not the same as never heard.

segments.title: check_world_consistency
segments.narration: Check world consistency evaluates only the four conditions registered in this ledger, not an entire engine project. Right now, one condition is violated.

segments.title: 1 → 1, but a different condition broke
segments.narration: I ask suggest world edit to make the repair account canon and repair a wrongly defined condition. It stages three operations. It approves nothing. Now the key beat: after the canon operation alone, the violation count stays at one. The traveller gate is fixed, but warehouse dispute breaks. The number did not move. The broken condition did.

segments.title: apply_reviewed_edit → pending_page_review
segments.narration: An early apply reviewed edit returns pending page review and keeps world revision zero. On the page, I approve canon, approve the condition repair, and reject the optional memory archive.

segments.title: Two approved · one rejected
segments.narration: The final reviewed preview is now bound to those exact decisions. The sequence is one, to one, to zero, and the provenance root count does not change.

segments.title: Approved operations only
segments.status: Revision 1 · immutable receipt · Gen's belief preserved
segments.narration: Apply reviewed edit now commits only the two approved operations. The receipt records the rejected archive, revision becomes one, and Gen's theft belief still survives with its memory and provenance. Canon Ledger changes canon without flattening the story its N P Cs disagree about.

takes.label: Take B — counterexample first
promptSet: Show me the NPCs who currently believe Tatsu stole the toolbox.
Follow the longest stored rumor trail for that accusation, ending with Nori.
Before changing canon, evaluate only the game conditions registered in this ledger.
Stage the repair account as canon, repair the wrong-layer condition, and surface the optional memory archive—but do not approve anything.
Show only the canon operation's registered blast radius.
Try to apply this patch now, before page review is complete.
Recheck the registered conditions using only the page's completed review decisions.
Apply patch revision one now that every operation has a current page decision.

segments.title: One violation can hide another
segments.narration: Here is a bug an ordinary consistency counter can hide. A change fixes one condition and breaks another, so the total stays one. Canon Ledger traces the N P C beliefs behind that counter and keeps objective canon separate from remembered rumor.

segments.title: search_world
segments.status: Five actors believe the theft claim
segments.narration: First I ask search world who believes Tatsu stole the warehouse toolbox. Five actors do. The result is bounded, and the same filter moves the visible page instead of disappearing into a chat transcript.

segments.title: trace_claim_provenance
segments.status: Accepted hops, distortion, and refusal stay distinct
segments.narration: I follow the longest stored trail to Nori. Gen witnessed the event, then Hana and Sue repeated distorted versions before Nori heard it at depth three. A low-trust branch was refused and remains inspectable as a failed transfer.

segments.title: check_world_consistency
segments.narration: Check world consistency evaluates four registered dialogue and quest conditions. It makes no engine-wide claim. In the current state, traveller can stay is the single violation.

segments.title: The identity changes while the count stays 1
segments.status: One gate fixed · another condition broken
segments.narration: Suggest world edit stages a repair-canon operation, a condition-definition repair, and an optional archive. It cannot decide any of them. Looking at canon alone, traveller can stay becomes satisfied, but warehouse dispute becomes violated. One is still one, yet the bug moved.

segments.title: pending_page_review
segments.status: No decision input exists on the Site tool
segments.narration: I try Apply early. It refuses with pending page review and commits nothing. Visible page controls record two approvals and one rejection; the Site tool has no field that can mint those decisions.
The reviewed projection now reaches zero registered violations. The registered condition-definition repair is included, while the optional memory archive remains rejected.

segments.title: Revision 1
segments.narration: The final apply commits only the two approved operations and returns an immutable receipt. Gen still believes the theft rumor, with its memory path intact. Canon Ledger debugs what each N P C believes without forcing the world and its characters to agree.
